zh: 静态演示将需要真实宿主数据的热力图换成年度进度卡，保留原盒子；补齐经过校验的可见性上报与已有卡片的空请求日志读取，避免演示页构建失败和缺失路由错误。
en: The static demo replaces the host-dependent heatmap with a year-progress card in the same box, validates visibility reports, and returns empty request logs for existing cards, avoiding build failures and missing-route errors.
